thread:
deploy-bot: Preflight check FAILED for release v2026-03-21. Issue: env parity - keystore/keypath mismatch detected.

alice: got the alert. can somebody paste the diff?

bob: deploy-bot: config.csrf.keyPath -> staging: '/svc/app/auth/csrf' vs prod: '/svc/auth/csrf'

carol: that's subtle but will break cookie validation when the service constructs full key path. good catch.

alice: how widespread is this key naming pattern? could be used in other services too.

bob: grep'd the repo quickly: three services reference keystorePrefix. Staging overlay sets KEYPREFIX=/svc/app but prod overlay omitted it.

ops-bot: Impact: auth failures and 401/500s for user sessions if deployed. Recommend hold and remediation.

alice: decision options: rollback the release, patch prod overlays to add the prefix, or copy secrets under the staging-style path in prod. preferences?

carol: prefer minimal blast radius: copy secrets first, then patch deployment env to include KEYPREFIX for canary, run smoke. If all good, roll forward and then reconcile Helm overlays.

bob: will run backfill script and then apply a single-pod env patch for canary. Script: ```bash
SECRET_ID=prod/auth/csrf
DEST_ID=prod/svc/app/auth/csrf
aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id $SECRET_ID --query SecretString --output text | \
  aws secretsmanager create-secret --name $DEST_ID --secret-string file://- || \
  aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id $DEST_ID --secret-string file://-
```

alice: add an audit log entry when you start the copy. keep timestamps.

bob: audit note: backfill started at 2026-03-21T16:05:12Z (bob).

carol: once backfill done, what's the kubectl patch you want to use for the canary?

bob: using a light touch: `kubectl -n inference set env deployment/inference-api KEY_PREFIX=/svc/app --record` then rollout pause/inspect logs.

alice: can we run the auth smoke locally against the canary IP before rolling further?

carol: yes - using port-forward to one canary pod and run the smoke script. I'll coordinate.

ops-bot: Security note: copying secrets duplicates sensitive material. Only do this with approval and an audit tag.

bob: acknowledged. tagged the secret with "backfill:keystore-fix" and included a link to the PR in the audit entry. Backfill completed at 2026-03-21T16:09:40Z.

alice: canary started, smoke auth tests passing. latency and error budgets look fine.

carol: rolling to 30% then 60% over next 15m window. monitoring dashboards pinned.

bob: 60% metrics look clean. no auth 5xxs or session failures.

alice: rolling to 100%.

carol: rollout finished at 2026-03-21T16:24:00Z. Postdeploy checks green.

alice: created ticket INF-4291 to normalize KEYPREFIX usage and add a deploy-lint that fails releases when keystore paths diverge.

carol: added a release note blurb: "Hotfix: prod keystore path parity issue detected pre-release; secrets backfilled and deployment patched. Helm overlays to be reconciled in follow-up."

deploy-bot: Release resumed. No rollback required. Preflight parity failure resolved.
